pages.title: Step 2: Loading Greenware
pages.text: When the kiln enters Stage 1, right-click the top of the pit kiln with greenware to load it. Up to 4 greenware items can be loaded.$(br2)To remove loaded items, right-click the top with an empty hand (non-Shift mode). Removes the last item placed.

pages.title: Greenware Types
pages.text: Four types of greenware can be loaded:$(br2)$(li)§bCrucible Greenware§r → §bGray Crucible§r$(br)$(li)§6Mold Greenware§r → §6Red Mold§r$(br)$(li)§7Brick Greenware§r → §7Fired Brick§r$(br)$(li)§8Vessel Greenware§r → §8Black Ceramic Pad§r$(br2)Each requires different firing conditions. Failure produces kiln waste shards.
Crafting recipe for crucible greenware. Requires drying mixed clay on a drying rack first.

pages.title: Adding Fuel & Sealing
pages.text: After loading, right-click the fire mouth with fuel to add it. Supported fuel types:$(br2)$(li)§6Firewood§r: fuel value 4 (1800 ticks/90 seconds each)$(br)$(li)§eStraw Bale§r: fuel value 1$(br)$(li)§8Rice Husk Char§r: fuel value 6 (best fuel)$(br)$(li)§7Charcoal Block§r: fuel value 1$(br2)After adding fuel, right-click the top with a kiln lid to seal. The kiln enters Stage 2.
Crafting recipe for the kiln lid. Sealing the kiln enters the heating stage.
Crafting recipe for straw bale. Low fuel value but simple to make.
§8Rice Husk Char§r is the best fuel for pit kiln firing, with a fuel value of 6 and the longest burn time. Obtained by smelting rice husk in a furnace.
